children: TOKYO, September 3 (Reuters) - Foreign investors turned netbuyers of Japanese stocks for the week ending on August 29, capital flows data showed on Thursday.    Foreigners bought a net 35.8 billion yen worth of shares inthe week through Aug. 29, after selling a net 763.4 billion yenin the week before that.    Japanese investors sold a net 824.0 billion yen of foreignbonds in the latest week after selling a net 1,976.8 billion yenthe week before.    Details of net investments were as follows (in billion yen):

FOREIGN INVESTMENT IN JAPAN:    (net)                                       stocks         bonds        bills    August 23 - August 29               +35.8        +509.1        +16.6     August 16 - August 22              -763.4r       +436.1r    -2,067.2
JAPANESE INVESTMENT ABROAD:    (net; a minus sign indicates net selling and inflows of funds into Japan)

stocks         bonds        bills    August 23 - August 29               +35.8        -824.0         -9.7     August 16 - August 22              -861.7r     -1,976.8r      -195.3r    August 9  - August 15            +1,391.3      +1,137.2r       -78.1

Notes:    - An "r" denotes a revised figure.    - Bonds include beneficiary certificates.    - Figures are based on contracts and are rounded.    - The MOF's capital flows data can be found in English at:    http://www.mof.go.jp/international_policy/reference/itn_transactions_in_securities/week.pdf
